test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Indian dancer was awarded the French Palme D'or by the French Government in 1977?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mallika Sarabhai__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mallika Sarabhai** received her first award in** 1977**.
 
• She was the **recipient of the "French Palme D'or"**, and in Paris** she was honoured as the 'Best Soloist Artist' **among 400 dancers from **25 countries **among other awards**.**
 
• Personally, she is a** **strong character with her own ideas and she feels that dance is a living language that you can interpret the way you think best**.**
 
• Mallika Sarabhai, one of the** leading exponents of Bharatnatyam and Kuchipudi**, is the** daughter of the dancing legend Mrinalini Sarabhai and the renowned scientist Vikram Sarabhai.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f2afbeaa633163f6f59230c3d152edf23554d9645877cdb7ec270c0f5c2c678.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Chitra Visweswaran is an **Indian Bharata Natyam dancer** who runs a dance school, the Chidambaram Academy of Performing Arts, in Chennai.
 
• Oopalee Operajita is a elder advisor to** Indian parliamentary and world leaders on public policy **and **international relations, and a classical Odissi and Bharatanatyam dancer and choreographer.**** **
 
• Dancing beauty **Kavya Madhavan is a trained classical dancer**. She has received many accolades for her dancing talent.
